title: Grilled Yellowfin Tuna Skewers with Cedar Glaze
description: A simple and flavorful recipe featuring grilled tuna skewers glazed with a cedar-infused sauce, perfect for a summer evening.

ingredients.name: Uruguayan Chimichurri
ingredients.notes: Available at most Latin American markets

instructions: Thread the tuna onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the cedar planks with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the cedar planks for 2-3 minutes on each side, until slightly charred.
Meanwhile, brush the tuna skewers with lime juice and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the tuna skewers for 2-3 minutes on each side, until cooked to desired doneness.
Brush the grilled tuna with Uruguayan chimichurri sauce.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
To make the cedar glaze, combine 1/4 cup Uruguayan chimichurri with 1 tbsp honey in a small bowl.
Brush the cedar glaze over the grilled tuna during the last minute of cooking.
